title: Ranking a measure over VALUES of the grouped column gives 1 everywhere
query: "Rank", IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Sales Amount] ), RANKX ( VALUES ( Product[Product] ), [Sales Amount] ) )

source.quote: The reason behind the constant value of 1 is that VALUES , for each cell, returns a table with a single row only.
source.supports: the article shows this mistake and its constant result

derivation: In each group the filter context holds one product, so VALUES ( Product[Product] ) has one row and the list has one value, the amount of that product. Its rank in a list of itself is 1. Scooter is BLANK in both expressions and dropped.
